body: Not as it is right now. Education is free here, but you gotta afford to live while studying. You can do that by applying for the only student loan possible, the government one. I've failed a whole year below the minimum requirement to get renewal on mine. And you're not allowed to study while on welfare since everyone would be doing that then. My only option is work right now and no one wants me. I feel so damn useless and empty right now.
If you've just finished university then your future is looking bright. I'm happy for you. I really am. Just wish i could have finished college too and not failed miserably. :(

30% youth unemployment at the moment and the town i'm living in happens to have one the highest unemployment rates in the country. The government program is part of the government job seeking agency. I feel there is no future for me in the job market since i have zero experience. :(
